label: DRT1 system
definition: A DRT system in which an organism possesses a genome-encoded DefenseFinder DRT_1 subtype locus represented by the mandatory DRT_1__drt1a and DRT_1__drt1b profiles.
observations: DRT1 branch under DRT system; distinct from the broader DRT system, the individual DRT_1 reverse-transcriptase profile rows, unresolved DRT1 phage triggers, direct RT products, host breadth, profile-pair activity criteria, and other DRT subtypes.
